result:
I fixed all 12 rules whose behaviour didn't match their docstring. A script that tests all 150 rules against what their docstrings say found these same 12 before the fix and none after.

| Rule | What was wrong | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| 13 | Discount only started above 12 units (`qty > 12`) | Starts at 12 (`>= 12`) |
| 150 | Discount only started above 50 units (`qty > 50`) | Starts at 50 (`>= 50`) |
| 47 | Discount started at 101 units (`qty >= 101`) | Starts at 100 (`>= 100`) |
| 18, 49, 84 | `round()` rounded the discount instead of flooring it | Floor division `//` |
| 42, 111 | "Whole" rules discounted only the units above the threshold | Discount on the full amount (`base`) |
| 99 | 8% instead of 7% | 7% |
| 117 | 4% instead of 3% | 3% |
| 68 | The 50,000 won cap only applied once the discount went over 100,000 | Always `min(disc, 50000)` |
| 69 | The cap was applied to the price before the 12% instead of to the discount | Compute the discount, then cap it at 100,000 |

STATUS: DONE
